import HartshorneLib.Chapter4KaehlerDifferentialPresheaf
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4KaehlerDifferentialLocalLift
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4GenericDifferentialLattice
import Mathlib.Topology.Sheaves.LocallySurjective
import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.LocallyBijective

/-!
# Local bijectivity of the differential comparison

The map from section-ring Kahler differentials to regular rational
differentials is locally surjective on integral schemes and locally injective
on smooth integral curves. The proofs use affine localization to produce local
preimages and standard-smooth neighborhoods to detect equality.
Consequently, sheafification identifies these differential presheaves as
sheaves of ground-field modules. No structure-sheaf module identification or
duality pairing is asserted here.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry Opposite

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]

/-- Every regular rational differential locally comes from a differential of
the section ring. -/
theorem kaehlerToRegularDifferentials_isLocallySurjective :
    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat))
      (kaehlerToRegularDifferentials X) := by
  constructor
  intro U η x hxU
  have hη := mem_curveRegularDifferentialLattice_of_mem_regularDifferentialSections
    X ⟨x, hxU⟩ η.property x hxU
  obtain ⟨V, -, hVU, hxV, ξ, hξ⟩ :=
    exists_kaehlerSectionsToRegularDifferentials_eq X hxU
      (show regularDifferentialSections X U from η).val hη
  letI : Nonempty V := ⟨⟨x, hxV⟩⟩
  letI : Algebra k Γ(X.left, V) := (X.left.overAlgebraMap k V).toAlgebra
  refine ⟨V, homOfLE hVU, ⟨ξ, ?_⟩, hxV⟩
  rw [kaehlerToRegularDifferentials_app_nonempty X ⟨x, hxV⟩]
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (kaehlerSectionsToRegularDifferentials X V ⟨x, hxV⟩ ξ :
      CurveRationalDifferentials X) =
    (regularDifferentialSectionsRes X hVU η : CurveRationalDifferentials X)
  rw [regularDifferentialSectionsRes_coe X hVU ⟨x, hxV⟩]
  exact hξ

/-- Equality of rational images detects equality of section-ring differentials
locally on a smooth curve. -/
theorem kaehlerToRegularDifferentials_isLocallyInjective
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] :
    Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat))
      (kaehlerToRegularDifferentials X) := by
  constructor
  intro U η ζ hηζ x hxU
  obtain ⟨V, -, hVU, hxV, hinj⟩ :=
    smoothCurve_exists_affine_kaehlerComparison_injective X x hxU
  letI : Nonempty V := ⟨⟨x, hxV⟩⟩
  letI : Algebra k Γ(X.left, V) := (X.left.overAlgebraMap k V).toAlgebra
  have hinj' : Function.Injective ((kaehlerToRegularDifferentials X).app (op V)) := by
    rw [kaehlerToRegularDifferentials_app_nonempty X ⟨x, hxV⟩]
    exact hinj
  refine ⟨V, homOfLE hVU, ?_, hxV⟩
  apply hinj'
  rw [NatTrans.naturality_apply, NatTrans.naturality_apply, hηζ]

/-- The sheafification of the section-ring differential presheaf, valued in
ground-field modules. -/
def kaehlerDifferentialSheaf :
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat)) (ModuleCat.{u} k) :=
  (presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat)) (ModuleCat.{u} k)).obj
    (kaehlerDifferentialPresheaf X)

/-- Sheafifying the genuine generic-germ comparison identifies Kahler
differentials with the intrinsic regular-differential sheaf as sheaves of
ground-field modules. -/
def kaehlerDifferentialSheafIsoRegular [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]
    [IsAlgClosed k] [IsProper X.hom] :
    kaehlerDifferentialSheaf X ≅ regularDifferentialSheaf X := by
  let J := Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat)
  letI := kaehlerToRegularDifferentials_isLocallySurjective X
  letI := kaehlerToRegularDifferentials_isLocallyInjective X
  haveI : IsIso ((presheafToSheaf J (ModuleCat.{u} k)).map
      (kaehlerToRegularDifferentials X)) :=
    (J.W_iff _).mp (J.W_of_isLocallyBijective (kaehlerToRegularDifferentials X))
  let e := asIso ((presheafToSheaf J (ModuleCat.{u} k)).map
    (kaehlerToRegularDifferentials X))
  let e' := asIso ((sheafificationAdjunction J (ModuleCat.{u} k)).counit.app
    (regularDifferentialSheaf X))
  exact e ≪≫ e'

/-- The sheaf isomorphism extends the original generic-germ comparison. -/
lemma toSheafify_kaehlerDifferentialSheafIsoRegular_hom
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] [IsAlgClosed k] [IsProper X.hom] :
    CategoryTheory.toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat))
        (kaehlerDifferentialPresheaf X) ≫
      (kaehlerDifferentialSheafIsoRegular X).hom.hom =
        kaehlerToRegularDifferentials X := by
  let J := Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat)
  change CategoryTheory.toSheafify J (kaehlerDifferentialPresheaf X) ≫
    (sheafifyMap J (kaehlerToRegularDifferentials X) ≫
      ((sheafificationAdjunction J (ModuleCat.{u} k)).counit.app
        (regularDifferentialSheaf X)).hom) = _
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← toSheafify_naturality, Category.assoc,
    sheafificationAdjunction_counit_app_val]
  exact (congrArg (fun f => kaehlerToRegularDifferentials X ≫ f)
    (toSheafify_sheafifyLift J (𝟙 (regularDifferentialSheaf X).obj)
      (regularDifferentialSheaf X).property)).trans (Category.comp_id _)

end
end Hartshorne
